name: Sachin Suvarna
message:
Thank you for your valuable guidance and support throughout my internship at CyberSage. It was a great learning experience, and I truly appreciate the opportunity to work under your mentorship.

Thank you once again for your time, guidance, and encouragement.

name: Sesha Gireeshan
message: The opportunities provided by CyberSage to me as an intern, right in the first year of engineering gave me hands-on experience of working in a cybersecurity environment. This also gave me lot of information about cyberattacks that industries face in current times and the methodology to detect and mitigate the same. I appreciate the way in which tasks and simulations were given based on real-life scenarios. This gave me enough confidence to further enhance my knowledge and experience in the field of cybersecurity as a specialisation in BTech from Atharva University. I thank the management and my peers in cybersage for helping me achieve this milestone.

name: Anuj Gawde
message:
I wanted to take a moment to thank you for giving me the opportunity to work with Team Sage. It has been a great learning experience for me, especially in areas like cybersecurity, threat detection, incident response, and security analysis.

Apart from the technical knowledge, the one-to-one sessions helped me a lot in building my confidence. I became more comfortable with speaking, explaining my work, presenting my findings, and communicating my ideas clearly. This is something I believe will help me throughout my academic and professional journey.

I’m truly grateful for the guidance, support, and practical exposure I received during this internship. It was a pleasure being a part of Team Sage, and I hope to stay connected with the team in the future.

Thank you once again, Sir, for this wonderful opportunity and experience. 😊💯

name: Shivangi
message:
✨️Grateful for an incredible internship experience at CyberSage, where I gained valuable industry exposure, learned new skills, and grew both personally and professionally.

A special thank you to all the mentors at CyberSage for their constant guidance, support, and for making the learning process easier and more engaging.
